fichas.title: Floor Slabs: Concrete Repair and Refurbishment
fichas.summary: Guidance for assessing and repairing existing concrete slabs and related building elements. It covers slab refurbishment options for fire and impact-sound insulation, concrete-condition testing, minimum reinforcement cover by environmental class, and concrete repair materials and procedures. The existing condition and damage should be surveyed before repair; joints and reinforcement protection require attention.

82

Minimum cover to reinforcement (Association of German Cement Industry_, refs)

New descriptions of concrete strength (Association of German Cement Industry-> refs)

Joints: elastic joints should be
replaced after max. 10 years.
If this is not done, damage can
be caused to the structure by
penetrating water (e.g. frost
damage).
Building elements: if the walls
or slabs are too thin for the fire
protection and sound insulation
requirements, then additional
measures are necessary.
Building materials for concrete
replacement:

cement concrete and cement
mortar (CC)
plastic-modified cement concrete and cement mortar
(PC C)
reaction resin concrete and reaction resin mortar (PC). Mortar and concrete with artificial
resin additives are not suitable
for the improvement of fire
protection requirements!
The surfaces must be cleaned
and have the surface strength
specified for the relevant treatment. Large areas of concrete
surface can be removed and the
reinforcement derusted by using
high-pressure water jetting. If it
is possible to provide sufficient
thickness of concrete cover,
then no further rust protection is
necessary for the reinforcement.
If only a thinner cover is possible,
then the reinforcement must
be protected against rust. In
this case, the requirements for
derusting are higher.

mortar (CC)

protection requirements!

reinforcement derusted by using

thickness of concrete cover,

necessary for the reinforcement.

then the reinforcement must
